newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL palm oil ends down on bearish export data.
newsitem.headline: KL palm oil ends down on bearish export data.

text.p: PALM OIL FUTURES PALM OIL PHYSICAL
Mar (3rd pos) 1,230 rgt/tonne Dec (south) 1,257.50
Open/Hi/Low 1,240/1,247/1,228 Prev close 1,260
Prev settlement 1,238 * sellers prices

PALM OIL FUTURES - Prices ended lower on the bearish Dec 1-20 export despite supportive Ivan Wong crop report. Late selling was seen in a brisk market which firmed earlier. Prices expect to trade within ranges next week due to the Christmas holidays. Mar futures support level 1,220 and resistance 1,250.
PALM OIL PHYSICAL - Some covering by refiners were seen earlier but prices closed slightly down in line with futures.
Supportive December crop data by forecaster Ivan Wong failed to aid the market which turned easier on afternoon liquidation.
On Friday, Malaysia's palm oil output in December is expected to fall 15 percent to 650,000 tonnes from November.

Wong forecast end-December palm oil stocks at 860,000 tonnes, compared with the Palm Oil Registration and Licensing Authority's (PORLA) 955,965 tonnes at end-November. Exports in December is projected at 625,000 tonnes against PORLA's 632,441 tonnes in November.
Earlier prices were marked higher on speculation that end-December stocks were estimated to below 900,000 tonnes.
The market also saw some technical selling when March futures fell below 1,230 ringgit level, they said.
It fell to a low of 1,128 ringgit before rebounding to close eight ringgit down at 1,230 ringgit ($487.03) a tonne.
Turnove was 2,089 lots vs 2,260 on Thursday.
Among physical, Dec (south) saw offers at 1,257.50 ringgit against bids at 1,252.50 after trading at 1,260 and 1,255.
Dec (central) was offered at 1,250 and bids at 1,242.50 with earlier trades of 1,255 and 1,250.
Jan (south) saw offers at 1,255 and bids at 1,250 with earlier trades at 1,260 and 1,255, Jan (central) at 1,250 and bids at 1,245.
Feb (south) was offered at 1,255 and bids at 1,250.
Among refined products, Jan/Feb/Mch RBD palm oil was offered at $527.50 a tonne FOB Malaysia, and Apr.May/Jun at $527.50. Jan was traded from $529 to $527.50.
Jan RBD palm olein saw offers at $567.50, Feb at $565, March at $562.50 and Apr/May/June at $555. Feb was traded at $565.
Jan RBD palm stearin was offered at $402.50, Feb/Mar at $405, and Jan/Feb palm fatty acid distillate saw sellers at $295. -- Tan Lee Lee - 603-230-7510 ($1 =2.5255 ringgit)
